title: A reconnect-to-shell pane leaves the chat room, and relaunch keeps its wrapper
body:
Review findings on commit bfb5457 (read its body and docs/remote-sessions.md). The human's standing requirement: proven by driving the real application; reproduce BEFORE the fix, verify AFTER, record both, the same way as bfb5457 (its card: `foreman kanban list 3e0wta --json`; reuse its setup: own release builds under target/agent/, config dir target/agent/appdata-s2hp4s restored afterwards, own pipe, test Remote andy@192.168.8.168 key login, a new /tmp directory per run, clean up what you create, never stop a foreman by name, install nothing on the Remote, do not run npx on the Remote).
Blocked by: Never replay a brief on reconnect: wrapper forms and a shell for commands foreman cannot vouch for
1. MUST FIX. The shell a Shell-class reconnect opens still receives chat, and a shell runs it. wm.rs reconnect skips carry_injects for it but still calls chat.rejoin (Member back in the room, cursor kept) and spawn_remote_session still attaches a Tunnel and a reply note (WithFirstPost). So posts made while the pane was down, every later broadcast and every @mention are pasted plus Enter into bash, and the first one carries the note: a curl command with the bearer token, executed. Fix: a pane reconnected as a shell because foreman could not vouch for its command is no longer an agent Member: it leaves the room (the room shows it left, the way an exited Member does), gets no Tunnel, no reply note and no chat delivery, and its saved workspace entry is a plain Remote shell. Posts addressed to it must fail or be reported the way a post to an exited Member is today, not vanish silently: find how that is reported and match it. The banner already says what happened; add that chat to this pane has stopped.
   Reproduce live BEFORE: `env FOO=1 claude "<brief>"` as in bfb5457's run, drop it, post a broadcast containing a harmless distinctive shell command (for example `echo CHATRAN > chat-ran.txt`), reconnect, and show the file exists in the directory and the curl note ran. AFTER: no file, nothing typed, the room shows the Member left, a post addressed to it is reported as undeliverable.
2. REPORT ONLY, do not change behaviour: establish with live evidence which non-agent panes receive typed chat today and say so in the final report and in docs/remote-sessions.md as a known limit if true: (a) a plain Remote shell opened from the launcher or `open --on R -- bash`; (b) a Rerun-class pane (`vi notes.md`, `htop`) before and after a reconnect; (c) for comparison, a local shell pane. One run each with a harmless broadcast. This is an existing product behaviour and a human decision; the final report must state it plainly under Decisions.
3. The wrapper is lost on relaunch. `wsl -d Ubuntu -u me -- claude "x"` relaunches as a bare claude run natively on the Windows Remote instead of inside WSL, and `npx -y @openai/codex@1.2 "x"` as a bare codex that may not exist; the bar says "start claude fresh"; the saved workspace keeps only the provider, so a restored pane resumes natively too. Fix: an accepted wrapper form relaunches THROUGH its wrapper with the wrapper's own options and no brief (wsl -d X -u Y -- claude --continue is a resume inside the same distro if the agent ran there; decide resume versus fresh per wrapper and say why; npx keeps its package and version, fresh). The workspace must save enough to rebuild that (a new optional field, absent for bare agents so existing files are unchanged and old builds still read new files; fixture tests both ways). Table tests. No live wsl or npx run is possible here: unit tests only, stated as unverified live. Also check whether "needs login" cleared by a wsl-wrapped agent wrongly clears the Windows host's own mark, and fix or state it.
4. Banner text. remote display_command: (a) for a PowerShell Remote a first word that needs quoting must be printed in a form that runs when pasted (call operator), (b) an argument holding a control character cannot be shown faithfully: say so on its own banner row instead of implying the line is paste-ready, (c) the Rerun and Agent banners still pass argv.join(" ") raw through inject_note: sanitise them the same way as the Shell banner. Tests for each.
5. Docs: one line in docs/remote-sessions.md on the inherent limit: foreman cannot see an agent behind an alias, a variable, a wrapper script or a provider it does not know, so such a command is rerun on reconnect with its arguments; and a user-written claude.bat/.cmd/.ps1 that embeds a brief is taken for the agent. Fix the stale doc comment on icons::IconKind::from_argv that still says a reconnect runs what it returns (comment only; do not change the function).
Hard rules as before: nothing assumes foreman on the Remote; a Remote agent's allowed actions are unchanged; no wire change to existing requests; nothing under cfg(test) spawns a process or socket outside the remote_probe network guard; do not type into or answer any Codex update prompt; do not mark anything on a Windows Remote, wsl, npx or Grok as tested.
Done when:
- BEFORE and AFTER for item 1 observed on the real Remote, and the three observations of item 2, recorded in the commit body and a short spec Results entry
- unit tests pin: a Shell-class reconnect leaves the room with no Tunnel, note or delivery; wrapper-preserving relaunch and its workspace round trip; banner cases
- docs and both providers' dispatch skill copies say what is true; cite-guard clean; full suite passes; cargo fmt leaves nothing uncommitted
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent; pwsh -File .claude/hooks/cite-guard.ps1 -All
